Estimating from the photo: the plate holds roughly 150 g of roasted broccoli florets and about 4 Brussels sprout halves (around 40 g). Roasting with oil adds some calories.

Broccoli, roasted with oil, comes to about 0.9 kcal/g, so 150 g is roughly 135 kcal. Brussels sprouts, roasted, are about 1.0 kcal/g, so 40 g is roughly 40 kcal.

The total is about 175 kcal for about 190 g of food.
